obligations.source_text: Create a pixel-verifiable, complex reference-guided photograph in which a scheduled orbital-station inspection makes microgravity legible through unsupported bodies, divergent object orientations, and active handrail control.

bindings.interior_phrase: station-module racks handrails and stowage establish a real orbital interior
bindings.float_phrase: multiple bodies or loose objects float without visible support or ballistic jumping cues
bindings.orientation_phrase: subjects and objects occupy different orientations with no shared downward direction
bindings.control_phrase: hands feet or restraints engage rails and loops to control motion
